eventDescription: [/lobby = quickly return to the lobby during a quest]
★ D Server does not allow any plugin to read memory. Only the D Server floor reader may be used. (Anti-cheat policy)
★ Use /daily to view daily quests. Completing them may reward a crate (refreshes at 08:00). Higher difficulty gives better crates. Each IP can obtain at most 2 crates.
★ Multiple clients are allowed only to transfer items between accounts (no account limit). Do not run multiple clients from the same IP while farming. (May result in a ban.)
★ D Server has high character-stat caps and is incompatible with builds from other servers. (See the guide for recommended level-200 builds.)
